The '''Dorellia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector's]] [[Mecetti Province]], between the [[Lastelle system/Legends|Lastelle]] and [[Nyssa system/Legends|Nyssa systems]].
